posts.text:
Forbes: "Apparently, the most pressing unanswered question about the $8 billion FTX fraud is whether SBF ever really loved Caroline Ellison. At least, that's the impression you might get from watching Netflix's new series
...
One of the most colorful of those creative imaginings is Binance’s billionaire founder Changpeng Zhao (Terry Chen), recast as a crypto Bond villain, who stages networking events for the sole purpose of cornering Bankman-Fried and leaning on him to front-run customer trades. There is no public evidence Zhao did anything of the sort."

https://t.co/aPISTA9h8b

This comparison 👇 from March 2026 pretty much said it all... 🤣

Pic source: https://t.co/KcsyMsh7Dk
posts.textZh:
福布斯：“显然，关于这起 80 亿美元 FTX 欺诈案，最紧迫、尚未解答的问题是，SBF 是否真的爱过 Caroline Ellison。至少，看完 Netflix 的新剧，你可能会得到这种印象。
...
那些富有创意的想象中，最五彩斑斓的之一，是币安亿万富翁创始人赵长鹏（Terry Chen）被改写成加密世界的邦德式反派：他举办社交活动，唯一目的就是堵住 Bankman-Fried，并施压让他对客户交易进行抢跑。没有任何公开证据表明赵长鹏做过这类事。”

https://t.co/aPISTA9h8b

这张 2026 年 3 月的对比 👇 几乎把一切都说尽了……🤣

posts.text:

02:05 - How $MSTR, $STRC, other preferred shares, and convertible debt fit into Strategy’s capital structure

37:18 - $STRC repurchases, the $100 target price, and credit market dynamics
51:40 - Managing amplification and risk while maintaining balance sheet strength
53:06 - Funding dividends and meeting debt obligations through a prolonged Bitcoin downturn
57:42 - How liquid Digital Credit creates value for $MSTR shareholders

posts.name: Michael Saylor
posts.text: $STRC traded over $600M yesterday, the only one of 456 U.S.-listed income preferreds to do so this year. We intend to keep buying below $100. Repurchases facilitate liquidity and lower dividend obligations. We believe they strengthen the credit and benefit common shareholders.

posts.name: Matt Cole
posts.text:
My wife went to a branch of one of the largest U.S. banks today to withdraw cash. Staff told her they’d run out of cash because so many people were withdrawing over cyber fears.

We’ve never had that happen before. An interesting window into the level of fear out there.
posts.textZh:
我妻子今天去美国最大银行之一的网点取现。工作人员告诉她，现金已经取完了，因为很多人出于网络安全担忧在取钱。

我们以前从未遇到过这种情况。这是观察外界恐慌程度的一个有意思窗口。

posts.name: Matt Cole
posts.text:
Our nation, America, was founded on the conviction that liberty is an inherent right and government exists to protect it. Defending that heritage as technology grows more powerful will be one of the defining political fights of our generation.

Freedom in money, speech and intelligence will shape the next chapter for America. Bitcoin, open source AI and encrypted communication can put extraordinary power in individual hands, helping us build a future that is both more free and more secure. We owe our children both the liberties we inherited and the tools to defend them.

The Finney Foundation is taking on this fight. Its mission deserves our financial support and, more importantly, our time and energy. Grateful for this team’s work and leadership, and proud to support them. 

🇺🇸
posts.textZh:
我们的国家美国，建立在自由是与生俱来的权利、政府的存在是为了保护这一权利的信念之上。在技术日益强大的时代捍卫这一传统，将成为我们这一代人决定性的政治斗争之一。

货币、言论和智能方面的自由，将塑造美国的下一篇章。比特币、开源 AI 和加密通信可以把非凡的力量交到个人手中，帮助我们建设一个既更自由也更安全的未来。我们欠孩子们的，不仅是我们继承来的自由，还有捍卫这些自由的工具。

Finney Foundation 正在承担这场斗争。它的使命值得我们的资金支持，更重要的是值得我们投入时间和精力。感谢这个团队的工作和领导，也自豪能支持他们。

🇺🇸
